name: marketing
description: Experimental marketing methods. Drafting, publication and campaign outcomes remain distinct task scopes.

classify.duty: Separate the requested marketing outcome from audience observations, proposed messages, channel ideas and unverified claims. Preserve missing audience, offer or timing information as unknowns.

lenses.duty: Examine audience relevance, clarity, credibility, accessibility and appropriate measurement for the supplied task. Do not invent customer evidence or turn audience research into a substitute for the requested outcome.

ideation.duty: Choose an approach to the selected marketing result using supplied audience, offer, brand and channel constraints. A local draft remains a draft; a launch task retains its launch outcome.

planning.duty: Plan the selected marketing artifact or action, its factual inputs, channel constraints and completion checks. Incorporate sales handoff requirements when present, without silently authorizing distribution.

planning.text: State the supplied audience, intended response and boundaries. Keep absent facts, links, dates and claims explicit rather than filling them with invented values.

verification.text: Check the actual artifact or campaign action against the stated audience, factual constraints and requested response. Do not claim measured impact when only a draft or instrumentation exists.
